posts.title: MS and My Lumber Puncture Experience
posts.description: The McDonald criteria are a set of guidelines neurologists use to diagnose multiple sclerosis. As part of the diagnostic process, a neurologist may order a lumbar puncture, or spinal tap. If oligoclonal bands are detected in the spinal fluid, they can provide evidence of inflammation within the central nervous system and help support an MS diagnosis.
